default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1368.title: Seasonal-profile deviation fade
E-1368.hypothesis: Price's move from the open, compared with its own average at the same minute over 20 sessions, measures an abnormal intraday excursion; liquidity providers fade the excess back toward the usual profile.

E-1369.title: Efficiency-ratio trend start follow
E-1369.hypothesis: When net movement is close to total path length (Kaufman efficiency), flow is one-sided and slow participants keep chasing; follow the first bar where efficiency crosses the threshold.

E-1370.title: Autocorrelation-regime bar follow/fade
E-1370.hypothesis: Rolling lag-1 return autocorrelation tells whether the tape is trending (follow the last bar) or bouncing (fade it); trade the bar's direction accordingly when the regime is clear.

E-1371.title: Previous-close reclaim after dwell
E-1371.hypothesis: After trading on one side of yesterday's close for a while, the first close back across it shows overnight-position holders switching sides; follow the cross.

E-1372.title: Widest-bar close-extreme follow
E-1372.hypothesis: The widest bar of the recent window closing in its top or bottom quarter shows aggressive one-sided orders that did not meet resistance; follow it.

E-1373.title: Lowest-volume bar break
E-1373.hypothesis: A bar with the lowest volume of the window marks a pause in participation; the close that breaks its range shows who resumes first, follow that side.

E-1374.title: CCI band re-entry fade
E-1374.hypothesis: A CCI excursion beyond its band followed by a return inside suggests the stretched move is exhausted and late entrants are trapped; fade back.

E-1375.title: Chaikin money-flow extreme follow
E-1375.hypothesis: Volume-weighted close location strongly positive or negative over a window means closes keep landing near the bar extreme on volume; follow the cross.

E-1376.title: Heikin-Ashi colour flip after a run
E-1376.hypothesis: A smoothed candle changing colour after a run of the opposite colour marks a turn that the smoothing filters from noise; follow the flip.

E-1377.title: Triple-EMA stack alignment follow
E-1377.hypothesis: Fast above middle above slow EMA all in order means trends at several horizons agree; follow the bar where the stack first aligns.
